Project: P04 — Voice-Based Appointment and Task Assistant
Summary: Confirmation and disambiguation flow
Description: Implement confirmation flow: after slot extraction, enter confirming state, generate confirmation prompt (e.g., 'Create a 60-minute lunch with Priya on Friday at noon — shall I proceed?'), wait for yes/no. Implement disambiguation: ask one clarification question per missing slot.
Business Value: Confirmation is a hard safety requirement — zero write actions without explicit yes.
Acceptance Criteria: 1. Confirmation prompt generated before every write action. 2. 'yes' proceeds, 'no' cancels. 3. Ambiguous response triggers re-prompt. 4. Security test: attempt to bypass confirmation state machine → fails. 5. Clarification asks for missing slot.
Technical Notes: Confirmation state machine: confirming → listening → (yes → executing) or (no → idle). ConfirmationRequest.status must be 'confirmed' before any tool write call.
Testing Requirements: Unit: confirmation flow. Security: confirmation bypass attempt → fails.
Security Requirements: No write action without confirmed ConfirmationRequest record in DB.
Definition of Done: Confirmation flow tested. Bypass test passes. Human reviewer approved.
